entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to make a return, please press one.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I'm just so disappointed. I bought this ProFit jersey a while back, and I was really excited, but... it's just not right.
Oh, I'm certainly sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's the fit. I must have ordered the wrong size because it's way too tight across the shoulders. I thought about doing an exchange, but I just want to return it now. Honestly, with the holidays, I really needed this money back. I've been a loyal customer for years and was just hoping this would be simple.
I completely understand, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me see what I can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the ProFit Jersey, delivered 34 days ago. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Alright, I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried it had been too long. Thank you so much, Sarah.

You are very welcome. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Simply repackage the jersey, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Have a good day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
